correctness.rationale: With x=1/2+pt and a=−(1−4c)/(4p), the induced map is g(t)=t+a+pt²; a is a unit. This proves invariance, and f_c(x)−x=p(a+pt²) rules out fixed points. Modulo p the first p iterates visit all residues, so telescoping g^p(t)−t gives pa modulo p² because the sum of all squares vanishes for p≥5. For G=g^{p^n}, the reduction of G as a polynomial is a translation, so its Taylor coefficients of degree ≥2 are divisible by p and G'≡1 mod p. For n≥1 and increments in p^n Z_p, the nonlinear remainder lies in p^{2n+1} Z_p⊆p^{n+2} Z_p. The p return iterates therefore accumulate the normalized shift multiplied by 1+G'+⋯+(G')^{p−1}≡p mod p². This proves the induction on n (with n=0 from g mod p); restoring x gives the stated modulus and coefficient. Since each shift has valuation n+1 in x, every cycle attains all p lifts at the next level, giving the adding machine by inverse limit. Independent finite replay: for p∈{5,7,11}, n∈{0,1,2}, a∈{1,2,p−1,p+1}, reduce c=1/4+pa modulo p^{n+2}, iterate x↦x²+c exactly p^n times for every x≡1/2 mod p in that quotient, and compare with x+p^{n+1}a. All 8068 comparisons matched; the frozen p=5,c=−1 example also gives 28 modulo 125. At p=3,c=1,x=2, the third iterate is 2 modulo 27 instead of the proposed 11, confirming that the excluded case cannot just be included. The finite replay does not prove the unrestricted n claim.

evidence: DesJardins–Zieve's p>3 cycle-growth law applies to neutral growing polynomial cycles beginning at level one. Fan–Liao give persistent growth and odometers on minimal clopen components.
Jeong's criterion applies to g=t+a+pΔH with H=t³/3−t²/2+t/6, since ΔH=t² and H is 1-Lipschitz here.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Persistent growth gives the full-cycle structure, and the inverse limit gives the adding machine. Jeong gives ergodicity/finite-level transitivity independently but does not by itself compute the leading return coefficient.

evidence: DesJardins–Zieve Appendix B for p>3 gives F^p(x)≡x+p b_1∑_{j=0}^{p−1}a_1^j mod p³ for the level-one return F. Since a_1≡1 mod p, the sum is p mod p² and b_2(x)≡b_1(x) mod p.
In §4 the higher-level relation is p b_{m+1}(x+p^m t)≡t(a_m^p−1)+b_m∑a_m^j mod p^m. For m≥2, t=0 and a_m≡1 mod p give b_{m+1}(x)≡b_m(x) mod p.
For the given quadratic, f_c(x)−x=(x−1/2)²−(1−4c)/4, which computes b_1 modulo p directly. Every subsequent return derivative remains 1 modulo p by the chain rule.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The prior equations preserve the actual digit, not just its nonvanishing. Substituting the level-one digit and the growing cycle length p^{m−1} gives exactly the original displayed congruence with n=m−1. The independent proof's convenient sum-of-squares argument is not necessary to this direct prior implication.

originality.rationale: The exact family-specific formula was not located verbatim. It is nonetheless mechanically implied by the signed displacement computations in DesJardins–Zieve, not merely by a general theorem on transitivity. Work in the original x coordinate: the level-one residue 1/2 is a fixed residue, its return multiplier is f_c'(x)≡1 mod p, and its translated lift coefficient b_1(x)=(f_c(x)−x)/p≡−(1−4c)/(4p) mod p for every x in the ball. Appendix B's first-lift congruence and §4's later-lift congruence preserve this very coefficient mod p, pointwise. This yields the entire displayed return-shift law directly. Fan–Liao and Jeong also cover the structural consequences. No claim is made that DesJardins–Zieve explicitly name this parameter family.
residual_risks: No verbatim statement of the quadratic-family formula was located. Rejection rests on the prior explicit displacement equations, not on a claim of exhaustive search or prior verbatim publication.

value.rationale: An exact leading return digit on a natural ramified family is potentially more useful than merely knowing its cycles grow. Here that digit is already carried unchanged by prior cycle-lifting equations, and its initial value is read from one expansion of the quadratic. Minimality and conjugacy bring no separate uncovered result. No higher-order digit, new parameter case, or distinct use of the coefficient is established in the submitted claim.
